statement: Nebius says customer demand visibility now extends beyond 24 months, with some reservations running into the first half of 2028.
why: Multi-year forward reservations mean the fleet is effectively pre-sold, which underwrites further accelerator purchases and reduces the risk that current ordering is speculative.

impact.mechanism: Committed forward bookings give the operator contracted revenue against which to finance and order more GPU capacity.

evidence.source: KuCoin News (flash article), corroborated by Futu News
evidence.excerpt: Nebius customer demand visibility now extends beyond 24 months, with some reservations extending into H1 2028.

confidence.basis: Qualitative statement carried in a secondary flash article; no contracted dollar backlog figure is given.
